tei:div.tei:p: rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/

rtog ge ba rnams kyi mig gcig pu/ 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge zhes snyan pa'i 'brug sgra'i tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man khyab pa'i mkhas mchog de ni dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dus 'jug / gtsang nyang yul rig pa'i 'byung gnas las 'u yug zhes par mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor bzhad/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas pho brang 'u shang rdor zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ rgyal bstan gyi sgron me gcig pu gnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la gtugs te/ phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rnams la sbyangs pa byas pas/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i gnya' zhig gi slob bu dgu las bar tshar gsum gyi ya gyal/ 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge zhes mkhas snyan gyi grags pa'i ba dan dkar po lhun po'i gong ba la spud/ phyis chos rjai sa paṇa gyi zhabs la gtugs te/ rnam 'grel dang rigs gter sogs gsan/ sa skyar bshad pa mdzad cing phyogs kun gyi mkhas grags kyi spobs pa'i khengs pa dag gi thor tsugs rtser zhabs sor rjen par bkod de/ gangs can 'di na blo can thos pa can/ / bdag rgyud dregs pa'i khur gyis non pas kyang*/ / sna tshogs lta ba ston pa rnam 'grel gyi/ / gzhung 'di mthong na long ba bzhin du 'gyur/ / dran dang brtson 'grus blo gros sbyangs par ldan/ / gzhung mang thos dang bsam dang goms par ldan/ / legs bshad rtsom dang 'chad dang rtsod pa la/ / rigs pa'i seng ge rigs pa'i mig dang ldan/ / zhes mkhas bsnyems kyi seng ge'i nga ro phyogs kyi wa skyes dag gi rna bar lan brgyar brdungs/ yid srubs dpung gi ru mtshon bsnyil zhing mdo sngags chos tshul ji bzhin 'chad pa'i legs bshad kyi skyes bzang*/ skal bzang rna ba'i bcud du bstsal cing*/ brgal brtag rdo rje'i mtshon rnon zad du med pa'i rtsod pa gnam lcags kyi thogs mdas/ phas rgol gyi lo rtog brag ri phye mar btags shing*/ rtsom pa sdeb legs kyi me tog phreng ba blo gsal gdul bya'i mgul rgyan du bsgron pa ste/

de ltar 'khor lo gsum gyis rgyal bstan tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang btegs pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ deng sang dbus gtsang khams gsum na slob dpon bsod nams seng ge las mkhas btsun 'dzoms pa med ces drang srong gi ngag las rdo rje'i tshig gis gtang rag phul/ gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yang mkhas pa chen po zhang ston mdo sde dpal ba/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan sogs rgyun 'dzin gy-i mkhas dbang gser ri'i 'phreng ba bstar ba ltar mang du byon zhing*/ phyi rabs gdul bya'i bgo skal du bzhag pa'i legs bshad kyang tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rnam bshad la rgyas pa rigs mdzod dang*/ bsdus pa rigs grub ces gnyis dang*/ de'i bsdus don bcas mdzad pas rnam 'grel la bod 'grel gyi thog ma'i lam srol btod/ rigs gter gyi rnam bshad la rigs pa grub pa zhes bya ba mdzad nas rigs gter la gzhan 'grel gyi spobs pa yangs por phyes/ mdor na 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi mar shar ba ltar mdzad/ de nas brgyud pa'i ding sang gi bar du sa dge bka' rnying dag gi chos grwa rnams su rnam 'grel rnam 'grel zhes phyogs kyi 'dzin ma'i rgyal rnga rdung ba 'di yang sa skya paṇa chen dang*/ khong gi bka' drin gtso bor nges so/ sku tshe'i smad du chos rje hor yul du phebs skabs/ dpal sa skya'i gdan sa'i khur chen bzhes te/ chos sde chen po'i 'chad nyan gyi rgyun 'dzin gtso bo mdzad/ de rjes bla ma 'phags pas hor yul du snga phyi thengs gnyis tsam bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po dang*/ phar tshad sogs kyi lung len phyir gdan zhu byas kyang chos grwa chen po'i 'chad nyan gyi khur dor te hor gseb tu ma phebs/ de ltar thub bstan gser gyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor ba'i mur dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus dkyil chu glang 1253lor dgongs pa rdzogs/ gsung rtsom ni rnam 'grel gyi bsdus don rig pa'i sdom dang*/rnam bshad rigs mdzod/

tshad ma rigs gter gyi 'grel pa rigs pa grub pa/dbu ma srog gi 'khor lo sogs nyung shas las da lta bdag cag gi mjal ba'i skal ba ma byung*/ zhes pa'ang thub bstan nyi mas so// // PAGE rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ PAGE -PAGE 8--PAGE 7-
